name: Shandong Kaisheng New Materials Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shandong Kaisheng New Materials Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of fine chemical products and new polymer materials in Mainland China, Japan, South Korea, and internationally. The company offers inorganic chemicals, carboxyl chlorides, and hydroxyl chlorides; high-purity aramid polymer monomers; chloro ethers; and thionyl chloride, iosophthaloyl chloride, terephthaloyl chloride, p-nitrobenzoyl chloride, 1-(2-chloroethoxy)propane, sulfuryl chloride, and chloroacetyl chloride.
